inputs.topic: A paper plane folds itself from a sticky note and carries a single word across a desk.
inputs.keyTakeaway: Small ideas travel further than you think.
inputs.neverClaim: No product, brand or performance claims.
inputs.source: User idea in chat; no source files.
inputs.audio: synthesized: soft tick per fold, whoosh on launch; no VO; -14 LUFS

direction.look: Flat paper cut-out on a warm desk, soft top light, gentle paper grain.
direction.pacing: stylized: shots >= 0.7s, the launch shot holds 3s.
direction.persistentActor: The sticky note that becomes the plane, keeping its accent corner.
direction.camera: Slow push in on the desk, cut to an insert of the fold, crane up to follow the flight.
direction.signatureMoves: The note folds into the plane; the word rides the wing; the plane lands as the period of the sentence.
direction.avoid: Default centered title over gradient; everything fading in at once.

beatGrid: No score; cuts land on fold ticks at 1.786s and 2.550s.

build.audio: audio_tools.py sfx for ticks and whoosh; mix to -14 LUFS

gotchas: Keep the accent corner visible in every shot so the actor stays on-model.

text.picture: A tidy desk; a single orange-cornered sticky note reads 'idea'.
text.job: Hook: the note is the hero.
text.transition: The note's corner lifts and matches into the fold insert.

text.picture: Two quick folds crease the note into a dart.
The plane launches; the word 'idea' rides the wing across the desk.
text.action: In: plane at rest; main: launch and glide; out: dip toward the notebook.
text.camera: Crane up following the arc, subject >= 1/3 of frame.
text.transition: The plane's nose becomes the period of the closing line.

text.picture: The plane lands as the period: 'Small ideas travel far.'
